title: Little Pattern Trail
tagline: A free pattern puzzle for parents and kids while waiting for food.
metaDescription: Play a short original pattern puzzle together at a restaurant, in a waiting room, or while waiting in line. Tap the next shape to finish each trail.

data.description: Spot the repeating shapes and tap the next one. Each short trail is designed for a parent and child sharing a phone while waiting for food.
howToPlay: Look at the repeating shapes in the trail.
Tap the shape that comes next.
Take turns explaining the pattern, or pause whenever you need.

faq.question: What games can we play while waiting for food at a restaurant?
faq.answer: Little Pattern Trail offers short touch puzzles on one phone. Pause between trails when your food arrives.

faq.question: Is this a free online game for kids to play while waiting in line?
faq.answer: Yes. Play in your browser with a parent; no download is needed.
